news.title: Fed minutes show willingness to consider interest rate increases - Axios
news.zh: 聯準會會議紀錄顯示願意考慮升息
news.impact: 聯準會可能升息，影響股債市場走勢與企業融資成本

news.title: OpenAI will reserve portion of IPO shares for retail investors, CFO tells CNBC - Yahoo Finance
news.zh: OpenAI將為散戶投資者預留IPO股份，首席財務官告訴CNBC
news.impact: OpenAI IPO進展，散戶參與機制明確，市場關注度提升

news.title: Constellation Brands, U.S. maker of Modelo and Corona, withdraws 2028 guidance due to uncertainty - CNBC
news.zh: Constellation Brands撤回2028年業績指引，原因為不確定性因素
news.impact: Modelo及Corona製造商下調預期，消費者信心與銷售面臨挑戰

news.title: Nexstar asks states, including Colorado, for $150M bond to cover damages from order slowing merger with Tegna - The Colorado Sun
news.zh: Nexstar向包括科羅拉多州在內的州政府申請1.5億美元債券，以彌補Tegna併購交易延遲造成的損害
news.impact: 併購受阻需融資賠償，廣播電視業整合面臨法律障礙

news.title: The SpaceX IPO Is Elon Musk’s Most Audacious Product Launch Yet - Bloomberg.com
news.zh: SpaceX IPO是馬斯克最大膽的產品發佈
news.impact: SpaceX IPO預期，太空經濟商業化加速，科技產業關注焦點

news.title: FDIC Approves Proposal to Implement GENIUS Act Requirements and Standards - Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) (.gov)
news.zh: 聯邦存款保險公司核准實施天才法案要求與標準
news.impact: 銀行監管標準更新，金融機構合規成本與風險管理規範提升

news.title: Goldman Sachs private credit fund narrowly misses a redemption crisis
news.zh: 高盛私募信貸基金險些陷入贖回危機
news.impact: 高盛信貸基金流動性緊張，影子銀行風險暴露，系統性風險預警

news.title: What Anthropic’s too-dangerous-to-release AI model means for its upcoming IPO
news.zh: Anthropic過於危險而無法發佈的AI模型對其即將進行的IPO意味著什麼
news.impact: Anthropic IPO前AI安全爭議，監管不確定性影響估值與上市進展
